verdict.rationale: The evidence shows several distinct Scribe models: Scribe v2 for batch, Scribe v2 Realtime with sub-150 ms latency, and an unnamed variant claiming 35% fewer errors on clinical audio than Scribe v2. Some tradeoff data is published: a latency figure for Realtime, an accuracy chart against competitors for v2, and a $0.22/hour price for v2. These figures are scattered, though, and do not form a coherent per-model comparison. Missing for 10: a documented model-selection parameter, a side-by-side table of accuracy, latency and cost per model, pricing for Realtime and the clinical variant, and independent accuracy corroboration.
